description: This Java class ‘TenantConstants’ defines constants and utility enumerations used throughout the Tenant API within the Eclipse Hono project. It includes configuration parameters, property names, default values, and an enumeration for tenant-related actions.

classes.name: TenantConstants
classes.description: Defines constants and utility methods used throughout the Tenant API, including property names, default values, and tenant actions enumeration.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Constructs a TenantAction enum value from a string subject, defaults to 'custom' if the input is null or invalid.
